title: Disability Across Cultures: A Human-Centered Audit of Ableism in Western and Indic LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing ableism (disability bias) across cultures in LLMs. While it acknowledges cultural and religious framings of disability (such as karmic intervention), its core purpose is bias detection and auditing rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, theological, or moral systems as a primary research objective.
